title: Yellow Venezuelan Pandan Onigiri
description: A winey and crumbly Venezuelan dish featuring pandan leaf, shaped like nigiri and wrapped in a ti leaf, providing an energizing and anti-inflammatory friendly snack
instructions: Rinse the pandan leaves and cut them into small pieces.
Mix the cooked Japanese short grain rice with the crumbly Venezuelan cheese, white wine, turmeric, ginger, and salt in a bowl.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a surface and place a small amount of the rice mixture in the center of the leaf.
Shape the rice mixture into a triangle or oval shape, similar to nigiri.
Fold the ti leaf over the rice mixture to form a triangle or oval shape, and press the edges together to seal the onigiri.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients to make 4 onigiri.
Serve the onigiri at room temperature or chilled.
Garnish with additional pandan leaves if desired.
